rules.description: Challenge filtered show listings (crawlers walking filter combinations)
rules.expression: (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/shows/year/") or lower(http.request.uri.path) in {"/shows/stats" "/shows/stats/"}) and http.request.uri.query ne "" and not ends_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), ".data") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.query, "utm_") and not cf.client.bot

rules.description: Challenge the user agents a daily headless-browser scraper rotates through (Chrome 118-121, Firefox 120-121, Lightpanda)
rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "Chrome/118.0.0.0" or http.user_agent contains "Chrome/119.0.0.0" or http.user_agent contains "Chrome/120.0.0.0" or http.user_agent contains "Chrome/121.0.0.0" or http.user_agent contains "Firefox/120.0" or http.user_agent contains "Firefox/121.0" or http.user_agent contains "Lightpanda") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/mcp") and http.request.uri.path ne "/healthcheck" and not cf.client.bot
